2608.27816.title: PersonaEdit: Representative Sample Selection for Personalized Model Editing
2608.27816.paper_summary: Personalization has attracted growing interest in LLM applications, yet existing retrieval-based approaches depend heavily on retrieval quality and degrade in long-term interactions. Model editing, which directly modifies internal model parameters to incorporate new knowledge, has demonstrated effective knowledge modification capabilities in factual knowledge editing tasks and may provide a potential solution for personalization. However, scaling model editing to personalization is non-trivial. Editing large amounts of user data increases computational cost and causes interference among edits, motivating the need for effective sample selection. To address this issue, we propose, PersonaEdit, a hidden representation clustering strategy that selects representative editing samples through proportional stratified sampling. Experiments show that model editing is effective for personalization, and that our selection strategy preserves most of the performance while substantially reducing the number of required editing samples. Beyond standalone editing, we find that combining model editing with retrieval-based prompt augmentation further improves personalization, as edited knowledge and retrieved context provide complementary information. These results demonstrate the potential of model editing as an efficient and scalable approach for LLM personalization.
2608.27816.paper_summary_zh: 個性化在大型語言模型應用中引起了越來越多的關注，然而現有的基於檢索的方法在很大程度上依賴於檢索質量，並在長期互動中表現不佳。模型編輯直接修改內部模型參數以納入新知識，已在事實知識編輯任務中顯示出有效的知識修改能力，並可能為個性化提供潛在解決方案。然而，將模型編輯擴展到個性化並非易事。編輯大量用戶數據會增加計算成本並導致編輯之間的干擾，這促使了有效樣本選擇的需求。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了PersonaEdit，一種隱藏表示聚類策略，通過比例分層抽樣選擇代表性的編輯樣本。實驗表明，模型編輯對個性化是有效的，並且我們的選擇策略在顯著減少所需編輯樣本數量的同時保留了大部分性能。除了獨立編輯外，我們發現將模型編輯與基於檢索的提示增強相結合進一步改善了個性化，因為編輯的知識和檢索的上下文提供了互補的信息。這些結果展示了模型編輯作為一種高效且可擴展的LLM個性化方法的潛力。
